about.body: The S54 is BMW M's naturally aspirated 3.2-litre inline-six petrol engine, produced from 2000 to 2008. It's the engine that powered the E46 M3 and the Z4 M, and it's regarded as one of the classic M engines from the naturally aspirated era. In the E46 M3, the S54 produced 338 bhp, while the Z4 M application delivered 330 bhp — a modest difference in output between the two applications, both of which we work on regularly.

byModel.body: The S54 appears in two principal applications. The E46 M3 (2001–2006) is the most common S54 application we see — a car that's now well into enthusiast ownership and frequently requires engine work to maintain its original performance. The Z4 M (E85/E86, 2006–2008) uses the same engine, though in a different chassis with a different engine bay layout. Both applications share the same core S54 engine with minor output differences.

compatibility.body: Because the S54 is used across only two applications — the E46 M3 and Z4 M — the compatibility question is simpler than with some of the more broadly-deployed engines in our network. An S54 from an E46 M3 isn't automatically a drop-in match for a Z4 M, even though the base engine code is the same. Ancillaries, mounting, and engine bay packaging all differ between the two chassis. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
